semantic_correction.stem: A Medicare beneficiary asks what the Annual Wellness Visit (AWV) is designed to accomplish. Which response by the nurse is most accurate?

options.A: It includes a health risk assessment and develops or updates a personalized prevention plan.
options.B: It is primarily a comprehensive diagnostic physical examination for evaluating new symptoms.
options.C: It is limited to measuring blood pressure and reviewing the current medication list.
options.D: It replaces other age- and risk-appropriate preventive screening services for the year.

semantic_correction.rationale: Current CMS guidance states that the Medicare Annual Wellness Visit includes a health risk assessment and is designed to develop or update a personalized prevention plan. CMS distinguishes the AWV from a routine physical examination and lists multiple preventive assessment and planning components, including review of functional ability and safety, screening schedules, risk factors, personalized health advice, and appropriate referrals. The AWV therefore does not replace other indicated Medicare-covered preventive services.
semantic_correction.educational_objective: Explain that the Medicare Annual Wellness Visit centers on a health risk assessment and a personalized preventive health plan rather than a routine comprehensive physical examination.

audit_findings_append.finding: The revised item accurately tests the purpose of the Medicare AWV as HRA plus personalized prevention planning rather than a diagnostic physical exam.

option_audit.A: Correct. It matches CMS's stated purpose and required HRA component of the AWV.
option_audit.B: Incorrect. CMS distinguishes the AWV from a routine or diagnostic physical examination.
option_audit.C: Incorrect. The AWV includes many preventive assessment and planning elements beyond blood pressure and medication review.
option_audit.D: Incorrect. The AWV supports preventive planning but does not replace separately indicated preventive screening services.

ambiguity_check: No second defensible answer. A alone states the CMS-defined purpose of the AWV.
cueing_check: All four options are AWV-purpose statements of comparable length and specificity; no absolute-word or unique-length cue identifies A.
